In triangle ABC, point D lies on side AB and point E lies on side AC so that segment DE is parallel to side BC. If AD = 4, DB = 6, and DE = 5, what is the length of BC ?
When (2x - 3)(x² + 4x - 1) is expanded and like terms are combined, what is the coefficient of x ?

questions.subskill: Evaluating a function at an expression
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² - 3x. Which of the following is equivalent to f(a + 2) ?
Which of the following lists 2³⁰, 3²⁰, and 5¹⁰ in order from least to greatest?

A bag contains 5 red marbles and 3 blue marbles. A marble is drawn at random, its color is recorded, and it is put back. Then a second marble is drawn at random. What is the probability that both marbles drawn are red?
Two consecutive angles of a parallelogram measure (3x + 20)° and (5x)°. What is the measure of the larger of these two angles?

Two towns are 330 miles apart. At the same moment, one car leaves each town and drives toward the other town on the same road, one at 50 miles per hour and the other at 60 miles per hour. When the cars meet, how many miles will the faster car have traveled?

questions.subskill: Finding a linear function from its self-composition
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = ax + b, where a and b are constants and a > 0. If f(f(x)) = 4x + 9 for all values of x, what is the value of f(1) ?
A 5 × 5 × 5 cube is painted on all six faces and then cut into 125 unit cubes. How many of the unit cubes have paint on exactly two faces?

questions.subskill: Shortest path on the surface of a cylinder
questions.stem: A cylindrical column is 12 feet tall and has a circumference of 16 feet. A stripe is painted along the shortest path that winds exactly once around the column, from a point on the bottom edge to the point directly above it on the top edge. What is the length of the stripe, in feet?
In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, what is the slope of a line perpendicular to the line 3x - 4y = 12 ?

The table below shows values of an exponential function f.
x | 0 | 1 | 2
f(x) | 5 | 15 | 45
What is the value of f(4) ?

questions.subskill: Equilateral triangle inscribed in a circle
questions.stem: An equilateral triangle is inscribed in a circle with radius 6 centimeters. What is the length of one side of the triangle, in centimeters?
What is 0.5% of 240 ?

questions.subskill: Probability of the second draw without replacement
questions.stem: A bag contains 5 red marbles and 3 blue marbles. Two marbles are drawn at random, one after the other, without replacement. What is the probability that the second marble drawn is red?
A board is 12 feet long. A carpenter needs pieces that are each 1 foot 8 inches long. What is the greatest number of such pieces that can be cut from the board? (Ignore the width of the saw cuts.)

questions.subskill: Evaluating an inverse function at a value
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x³ + 2x + 1, and f has an inverse function f⁻¹. What is the value of f⁻¹(13) ?

questions.subskill: Area of a triangle from its three sides
questions.stem: A triangle has sides of lengths 13, 14, and 15 units. What is the area of the triangle, in square units?
A right prism has bases that are right triangles with legs of 3 inches and 4 inches. The prism is 10 inches long. What is the volume of the prism, in cubic inches?

A clock runs fast: for every 60 minutes of actual time, the clock advances 66 minutes. The clock is set to the correct time at 12:00 noon. What is the actual time when the clock first shows 11:00 p.m. that day?
What value of x satisfies the equation 0.2(x - 5) = 1.4 ?

questions.subskill: Vertex of an absolute value graph
questions.stem: In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, what are the coordinates of the vertex of the graph of y = |x - 3| + 2 ?

questions.subskill: Equation of a parallel line through a point
questions.stem: Which of the following is an equation of the line that passes through the point (3, 4) and is parallel to the line y = 2x - 5 ?
What is the sum of all the odd integers from 1 through 49, inclusive?
The odds in favor of a certain team winning its next game are 3 to 5. Based on these odds, what is the probability that the team wins?
In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, ABCD is a parallelogram with vertices A(1, 1), B(5, 2), and C(6, 5), taken in that order. What are the coordinates of vertex D ?
How many integers from 100 through 500, inclusive, are multiples of 6 ?
A bicycle wheel has a diameter of 28 inches. About how many complete revolutions does the wheel make when the bicycle travels 1 mile? (1 mile = 63,360 inches)

questions.subskill: Sum of the squares of a quadratic's roots
questions.stem: The equation x² - 5x + k = 0 has roots r and s, and r² + s² = 13. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Distance from a point to a circle
questions.stem: In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, what is the shortest distance from the point (8, 6) to a point on the circle x² + y² = 25 ?

questions.subskill: Proportions with a variable on both sides
questions.stem: What value of x satisfies the proportion (x + 2)/5 = (x - 1)/2 ?
The function f is defined by f(x) = -(x - 2)² + 7. For which values of x is f increasing?

questions.subskill: Area of a kite from its diagonals
questions.stem: The diagonals of a kite are 10 centimeters and 14 centimeters long. What is the area of the kite, in square centimeters?

questions.subskill: Converting decimal hours to hours and minutes
questions.stem: A trip took 2.4 hours. How long did the trip take in hours and minutes?

questions.subskill: Probability that a product is even
questions.stem: Two spinners are each divided into 4 equal sections numbered 1, 2, 3, and 4. Each spinner is spun once. What is the probability that the product of the two numbers is even?
A worker earns $16 per hour for the first 40 hours worked in a week and 1.5 times that rate for each hour over 40. Last week the worker earned $760. How many hours did the worker work last week?

questions.subskill: Annulus area from a tangent chord
questions.stem: Two circles have the same center. A chord of the larger circle is 10 units long and is tangent to the smaller circle. What is the area of the region between the two circles, in square units?
In how many different ways can 5 identical balls be placed into 3 different boxes, if any box may be left empty?
What is the radius of the circle inscribed in an equilateral triangle with side length 12 ?

questions.subskill: Splitting a job in proportion to rates
questions.stem: Two printers work at the same time on a 300-page job. Printer A prints 30 pages per minute and Printer B prints 45 pages per minute. If the pages are divided so that both printers finish at the same moment, how many pages does Printer B print?

questions.subskill: Evaluating an expression at a negative value
questions.stem: What is the value of 3x² - x when x = -2 ?

The tables below give values of the functions f and g.
x | 1 | 2 | 3
f(x) | 4 | 7 | 10
g(x) | 9 | 5 | 1
What is the value of (f + g)(2) ?

questions.subskill: Base angles of an isosceles triangle
questions.stem: In isosceles triangle PQR, PQ = PR and the measure of angle P is 40°. What is the measure of angle Q ?
Today is a Tuesday. What day of the week will it be 100 days from today?

A survey of 120 students recorded whether each student has a part-time job and whether each plays a sport. Of the 120 students, 45 have a job, 50 play a sport, and 20 have a job and play a sport. How many students neither have a job nor play a sport?
A shipping company charges $4.00 for the first pound and $1.50 for each additional pound or fraction of a pound. What is the cost to ship a package that weighs 5.3 pounds?
A square is inscribed in a semicircle of radius 5 so that one side of the square lies along the diameter and the other two vertices lie on the arc. What is the area of the square?
The price of Model A is 25% more than the price of Model B. The price of Model B is what percent less than the price of Model A?

questions.subskill: Reflection across a line not through the origin
questions.stem: In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, point P(4, 1) is reflected across the line y = x + 1. What are the coordinates of the image of P ?

questions.subskill: Probability of selecting a matched pair
questions.stem: Four married couples attend a meeting. Two of the 8 people are chosen at random to give a presentation. What is the probability that the two people chosen are married to each other?
Which of the following expressions is equivalent to 5 - 2(3 - 4x) + x ?

The table below shows values of a function f for several values of x.
x | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4
f(x) | 2 | 6 | 12 | 20
If the pattern continues, what is f(5) ?

questions.subskill: Surface area of a rectangular prism
questions.stem: A closed rectangular box measures 3 inches by 4 inches by 5 inches. What is the total surface area of the box, in square inches?
What is the greatest common factor of 12x³y and 18x²y² ?
Two angles form a linear pair. One angle measures x° and the other measures (3x - 20)°. What is the value of x ?
A paint color is made by mixing blue and yellow paint in a ratio of 3 to 5. How many quarts of blue paint are needed to make 2 gallons of this color? (1 gallon = 4 quarts)

questions.subskill: At least two of three independent events
questions.stem: Three independent events A, B, and C have probabilities 0.5, 0.6, and 0.7, respectively. What is the probability that at least two of the three events occur?
A rectangle is inscribed in a circle of radius 10 centimeters. The sides of the rectangle are in the ratio 3 : 4. What is the area of the rectangle, in square centimeters?

questions.subskill: Average cost with a fixed cost
questions.stem: A company spends $2,000 to set up production and then $3 to make each item. How many items must it make so that the average cost per item is $5 ?

Two candles are the same height when they are lit at the same time. The first candle burns down completely in 3 hours, and the second in 5 hours, each at a constant rate. After how many hours will the second candle be exactly twice as tall as the first?

questions.subskill: Circle equation by completing the square
questions.stem: In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, the graph of x² + y² - 6x + 4y = 12 is a circle. What are the center and the radius of the circle?
For an acute angle θ, sin θ = 0.6. What is the value of cos(90° - θ) ?

questions.subskill: Volume of a cylinder from its diameter
questions.stem: A cylindrical tank has a diameter of 10 feet and a height of 6 feet. What is the volume of the tank, in cubic feet?
The price of a book increased from $40 to $50. By what percent did the price increase?

questions.subskill: Addition rule for mutually exclusive events
questions.stem: A spinner lands on red with probability 0.25 and on blue with probability 0.35. It cannot land on both colors on the same spin. What is the probability that it lands on red or blue on one spin?
A worker earns $18 per hour and works 40 hours per week for 50 weeks a year. What are the worker's yearly earnings?

questions.subskill: Area of a regular octagon (cut corners)
questions.stem: A regular octagon has sides of length 2. What is the area of the octagon?

A sector with radius 6 inches and central angle 120° is cut from a circle of paper. The two straight edges are joined, without overlapping, to form a cone. What is the radius of the base of the cone, in inches?
For the function f(x) = x², which of the following is equal to [f(1 + h) - f(1)]/h for h ≠ 0 ?

questions.subskill: Counting outcomes for a target sum
questions.stem: Two digits are chosen at random, one at a time and with replacement, from the digits 0 through 9. What is the probability that the sum of the two digits is 9 ?

Let A and B be 2 × 2 matrices. The entries of A are 1 and 4 in its first row and -2 and 3 in its second row; the entries of B are 0 and 2 in its first row and 5 and -1 in its second row. What is the sum of all four entries of 2A + B ?

questions.subskill: Reference angles on the unit circle
questions.stem: What is the exact value of sin 150° ?

questions.subskill: Identifying a conic from its equation
questions.stem: In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, which of the following best describes the graph of 4x² + 9y² = 36 ?

questions.subskill: Checking a point against a system of inequalities
questions.stem: Which of the following points (x, y) satisfies both y > 2x - 1 and x + y < 5 ?
Which of the following is equal to 2⁻³ + 4⁰ ?
For x ≠ 0 and x ≠ -1, which of the following is equivalent to 1/x + 1/(x + 1) ?

questions.subskill: Area bounded by an absolute value graph and a line
questions.stem: In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, what is the area of the region bounded by the graph of y = |x| and the line y = 4 ?
A rhombus has diagonals of lengths 12 and 16. What is the radius of the circle inscribed in the rhombus?
For x > 0, which of the following is equivalent to √(50x³) ?

questions.subskill: Relative speed on a moving walkway
questions.stem: Standing still on a moving walkway, a traveler is carried its full length in 60 seconds. Walking at a steady pace along the moving walkway, the traveler covers the same length in 20 seconds. At that same walking pace, how many seconds would it take the traveler to walk the same length on the ground beside the walkway?
